facts.raw_span: 4 months of progressively worsening symmetric pain in the small joints of her hands, wrists, knees, and ankles
early morning stiffness lasting 2 hours daily
severe fatigue throughout the day
mild COVID-19 infection confirmed by SARS-CoV-2 PCR
denied fever, chills, night sweats, weight loss, rash, or appetite changes since recovering
erythrocyte sedimentation rate of 13 mm/hour
C-reactive protein of 4.3 mg/L
antinuclear antibody titer of 1:640
rheumatoid factor of 62.29 IU/mL
anti-cyclic citrullinated peptide antibody of 237.39 units
MRI of the hands demonstrated synovitis of the bilateral distal radioulnar joints and the left second metacarpophalangeal joint
tenosynovitis around the extensor carpi ulnaris tendon

concepts.why: The patient's symptoms of symmetric pain in the small joints, early morning stiffness, and elevated rheumatoid factor and anti-cyclic citrullinated peptide antibody levels are consistent with Rheumatoid Arthritis.

support_spans: antinuclear antibody titer of 1:640
contradict_spans: denied fever, chills, night sweats, weight loss, rash, or appetite changes since recovering
concepts.why: The patient's elevated antinuclear antibody titer is consistent with Systemic Lupus Erythematosus, but the lack of other typical symptoms makes this diagnosis less likely.

support_spans: mild COVID-19 infection confirmed by SARS-CoV-2 PCR
contradict_spans: anti-cyclic citrullinated peptide antibody of 237.39 units
concepts.why: The patient's recent COVID-19 infection could have triggered a reactive arthritis, but the presence of rheumatoid factor and anti-cyclic citrullinated peptide antibody suggests a more chronic condition.

rationales.F01: Symmetric small joint pain is a hallmark of Rheumatoid Arthritis.
rationales.F04: Post-COVID-19 Reactive Arthritis is a known complication of COVID-19 infection.
rationales.F08: Antinuclear antibody titers can be elevated in Systemic Lupus Erythematosus.
rationales.F09: Rheumatoid factor is often elevated in Rheumatoid Arthritis.
rationales.F10: Anti-cyclic citrullinated peptide antibody is highly specific for Rheumatoid Arthritis and rules out Post-COVID-19 Reactive Arthritis.
rationales.F11: Synovitis on MRI is consistent with Rheumatoid Arthritis and Post-COVID-19 Reactive Arthritis.
